name: Moonfire
body:
School evocation [light]; Level druid 9, shaman 9, witch 9

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, F (a moonstone worth 10 gp)

EFFECT

Range 60 ft.
Area cone-shaped burst
Duration instantaneous (see text)
Saving Throw Reflex half (see text); Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You unleash a blast of pale-white fire. All living creatures take 1d8 damage per 2 caster levels (maximum 10d8). Undead or shapechangers in the area instead take 1d8 damage per caster level (maximum 20d8). A successful Reflex save halves this damage. Any creature that is normally affected by moonlight must make a Will save or automatically undergo the effects of those abilities.

After the damage is dealt, the area continues to glow with the pale light, creating an area of bright illumination for 1 round per caster level. Additionally, shapechangers and undead are illuminated as per faerie fire for 1 round per caster level as the moonfire reveals their nature.
